$comment: ADR-0023 am. F items 2-3 (D-ARCH-020). Time-boxed overrides read by tools/ci/check-lockfile.mjs (kind "source": a non-registry source, matched on package + exact resolved) and tools/ci/check-dep-age.mjs (kind "cooldown": a security fix younger than 7 days). Entry: { package: "name@version", kind: "source" | "cooldown", resolved (kind source only), decision: DECISIONS.md ID, reason, granted: YYYY-MM-DD, expires: YYYY-MM-DD within 30 days of granted }. An expired entry fails the gate. New entries need security-analyst review (CODEOWNERS).
